shortDescription: GitHub-style user profile overview view in a dark theme.
fullDescription: Renders the user-profile-overview view in its default state with a GitHub-inspired top bar, profile summary sidebar, overview tab navigation, a popular repositories grid, and a yearly contribution activity heatmap. The view accepts serializable props for the selected tab, profile identity, repository cards, contribution totals, contribution month data, and selected year, while local presentational state keeps the search field, tab selection, and year buttons interactive immediately after render.
